pages.title: Dawn Amulet
pages.text: §lObtaining:§r Complete the ritual at the altar.$(br2)Base: a 7×7 area of any full light-emitting block. Redstone-powered lights do not count.$(br2)Place 8 pedestals on the base edge.$(br2)Put a Dawn enchanted book on the center pedestal.$(br2)When the ritual ends, it becomes the Dawn Amulet.
§lSetup:§r$(br2)Center: Dawn enchanted book$(br)Edge midpoints: blaze powder$(br)Corners: stardust$(br2)Right-click the center pedestal to begin.
